intervals.label: collaboration operating PHENIX
intervals.note: Start is the collaboration's own sourced formation date; end is PHENIX's sourced end of data taking. This replaces a previously-collapsed single 1991-08 to present interval that had incorrectly carried status 'completed' across the entire 1991-2016 period during which PHENIX was actually forming, commissioning and actively taking data (v0.2 A3/A13; RESEARCH_AGENT_RULES rule 8: do not collapse richer sourced history into one row). Mirrors the staging already used on experiment:phenix and detector:phenix.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who built and ran the PHENIX heavy-ion experiment at Brookhaven's RHIC collider from 2000 to 2016.
summary.technical: Collaboration formed August 1991 from the merger of the TALES, SPARC, OASIS and DIMUON proposals; operated the PHENIX detector at RHIC IP8 from first collision (2000-06-15) to the end of data taking (2016).
